apis.name: Paystack API
apis.why_notable: Leading African payments API for cards, bank transfers, and mobile money with strong developer docs.

apis.name: Flutterwave API
apis.why_notable: Pan-African and emerging-market payments API covering cards, bank, USSD, and mobile money.

apis.name: Printify API

apis.name: BitPay API

apis.name: NOWPayments API

apis.name: Fixer API

apis.name: CurrencyAPI

apis.name: FreshBooks API
apis.why_notable: Invoicing and time-tracking API popular with freelancers and small service businesses.

apis.name: Medusa.js Admin API

apis.name: PayU API

apis.name: Worldpay API
apis.why_notable: Enterprise card payments and access APIs from a long-standing global acquirer.

apis.name: Gumroad API
